$comment: The one description of how the MCP servers are published outside this repository. packaging/package.py reads it to build the Python wheel, the MCP bundles and the registry manifests; publish_docker.yml reads it to label the per-server image tags. Every name here is one a registry, a package index or a client will look up, so change it only together with docs/tools/mcp-packages.md.
workspaceDescription: Folder the server may read and write. Every path in a tool call is resolved inside it and can never leave it.
